name: Strength
summary: The big lifts — squat, press, deadlift — on a twelve-week cycle that adds weight to the bar on purpose, not by accident.

name: Engine

name: Foundations
summary: Where everyone starts. Four weeks of the movements, the language and the habits, at half the class size.
